scope: Angle wrapping and3D line parameters used by path corners.

mappings.qualification: Finite inputs and intermediates, disjoint valid input/output buffers; underflow to zero is retained but overflow/NaN/infinity are excluded. The Boolean only tests whether the stored inverse-square scale is nonzero. It must not be interpreted as proof that two finite3D segments intersect. This is a dependency of51c150 path-corner construction, not the completed corner or51d7b0 steering contract. No authored command credit; no re-credit for square root or arithmetic support. Managed replay compiled only; native comparisons use an independent exact-arithmetic model.
mappings.comparisonStatus: Original-PC comparisons passed; portable replay compile only.
